current_behavior.reason: the in-process hrtime deadline is lost on restart; load() reconstructs it only if persisted unavailableUntil is still in the future according to Date.now(), which is false after the forward wall-clock jump

impact: A CAPTCHA/rate-limit/account-local cooldown can end early after a process restart if the wall clock jumped forward before restart. The fresh monotonic guard correctly protects the current process but is not a restart-safe floor under an untrusted wall clock.
required_contract: Do not weaken the new in-process monotonic guard.
Persist enough restart-safe cooldown information to avoid trusting Date.now() alone after a clock discontinuity/restart, or fail closed when elapsed real time cannot be proved.
A restart before the intended real duration elapsed must keep the account unavailable even when wall time jumped forward.
Normal restart with a trustworthy wall clock and expired cooldown must remain available.
accountStore.load() between requests must not erase the current-process monotonic deadline.
